meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided on it, and when?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote things, and a paraphrase from a study guide isn't a crime. Show me the page.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
Be very careful with your next sentence, Hale. My daughter won her appeal, and you just tied her to my son to make a point. I'll be repeating that to the principal before I leave this building.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for entering it without contacting me, and an apology for raising my daughter's case, with nothing placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: she stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, apologies, and a trip to the principal; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended well before her time ran out.
What moved her: you owned the missed call home in one sentence and moved on, which earned you one small sign of ground because she respects a plain admission about procedure.
What cost ground: you tied Owen to his sister's old case and said it ran in the family, which turned a promising evidence point into an attack on her children and confirmed her belief that this school punishes first.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence about a line that is not in the play never touched that night, because no times or dates were raised; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked to see the page, put the essay's line next to the play text so she could check it herself, and leave her daughter out of it entirely.
